description: DNS Server test that resolves the demo hostname against public resolvers (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, Google 8.8.8.8, Quad9 9.9.9.9). Surfaces DNS-layer failure modes - delegation breakage, TTL anomalies, NXDOMAIN floods - that look like 'the app is down' to a customer but never show up in app-level metrics.
